title: gagea pygmaea subsp. iberica
intro: Gagea pygmaea subsp. iberica, commonly known as the Dwarf Winter Aconite, is a plant species within the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders. The therapeutic actions of Gagea pygmaea subsp. iberica are attributed to its ability to act as a sedative and anxiolytic, with its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and saponins, contributing to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions.
